items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 1:21 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Certificates of Service
notes:
Mayor B. Vrbanovic recognized Councillor A. Owodunni  (Member of Council from 2022 to 2026) for his contributions to Council and the Kitchener community. Councillor A. Owodunni was presented a token of appreciation on behalf of Council.

Mayor B. Vrbanovic recognized Councillor S. Stretch (Member of Council from 2024-2026), acknowledging her service to Council and to the Kitchener community. Councillor S. Stretch was presented a token of appreciation on behalf of Council.

items.title: To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for November 6, 2026.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 1:55 p.m.
